body: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
plain_description: **Automate business processes and build AI workflows with a visual canvas and custom code.** Connect 1,500+ integrations and use your own data, models, and tools. Self-host or use n8n Cloud.
technical_description: Fair-code platform for building and deploying AI agents and workflows. Combines a visual editor with JavaScript, Python, and npm packages, and supports integrations with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models. Can run self-hosted or in the cloud; Docker installation is documented.
title: n8n – The Platform for AI Agents and Workflow Automation
